cohort: 3319 mother-child pairs in the China-Anhui Birth Cohort Study (C-ABCS)
finding: Children born by elective caesarean section on maternal request prior to 39 weeks gestation had an increased risk of emotional and behavioral problems at preschool age.
mod_finding: Children born by elective caesarean section on maternal request were more likely to have total difficult problems (RR 1.519, 95% confidence interval 1.077 to 2.142) compared to those born vaginally.
